prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: third high-fidelity compositional comp for a desktop SaaS dashboard for a Brazilian padel teacher. Build the application interface itself at 1536x1024. Use a dark petroleum-green sidebar, an airy pale gray-green canvas, white compact surfaces, crisp understated typography, soft borders, and muted green accents. Composition C: after the page header and a compact row of daily metrics, organize today's schedule into three equal columns labeled Manhã, Tarde, and Noite; show realistic lesson cards in each with time, duration, lesson type, student names or group size, court, and scheduled status. Below the agenda, put a wider pending-tuition table on the left and a compact monthly revenue summary with a modest chart on the right. Include a clear new-class action and navigational context. Portuguese Brazilian UI, realistic fictional sample data, no full-bleed sports photo, no poster treatment, no unsupported commercial claims. Keep the hierarchy quiet and practical for a teacher checking the screen between court sessions.
